-
-### 2.3 GB300 long-context serving with HiCache and MTP
-
-Use this single-GPU, aggregated TP1/EP1 configuration for long-context, multi-turn workloads on GB300. It combines the NVIDIA NVFP4 checkpoint's embedded MTP head, CPU DRAM KV offload through HiCache, and pinned-memory PLE embedding offload.
-
-This serving configuration comes from [InferenceX #3816](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3816). [Run 37714835620, attempt 1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/37714835620) passed concurrency 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 48 and 64 on commit `e67ca6fc9ecf4cd57f27654bda8a3e9059923820`. Its [matching GSM8K eval](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/37714835620/job/113109083376) used real verification and scored 97.35% on 1,319 questions.
-
-The throughput sweep used InferenceX's simulated acceptance; the generated command uses normal MTP verification and does not claim those throughput numbers for production traffic.
-
-#### Prerequisites and memory budget
-
-- Use a Linux ARM64 GB300 host with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and a driver compatible with the image's CUDA 13.0 runtime. See [Docker installation](/docs/get-started/install#method-3-using-docker).
-- Reserve one GB300 GPU. The recipe keeps TP, PP, DP and EP at 1.
-- Budget 224 GiB of CPU memory for the combined target/draft KV and Mamba HiCache host pool, plus approximately 48 GiB for the offloaded FP8 PLE table and additional headroom for checkpoint loading and host processes. `--hicache-size` sets the combined cache budget; it is separate from PLE weight offload. Keep sufficient free host memory for both.
-- The Docker command mounts your Hugging Face cache to retain downloaded model files across restarts. The image digest and both target/draft checkpoint revisions are pinned to the validated configuration.
-
-#### Generate the launch command
-
-In the [Deployment panel](#deployment), select **GB300 → NVFP4 (NVDA) → Low Latency → Single Node**, and leave **PLE Offload** at **Auto** or **On**. The matched cell includes all five serving environment variables and the full argument set, including ReplaySSM, HiCache and pinned PLE offload. Choose **Docker** to use the pinned image, or **Python** for a matching local installation. Changing PLE Offload to **Off** produces an unverified configuration.
-
-The Docker wrapper comes from the shared command builder and is adapted from the validated Slurm/Enroot launch; it has not been run separately on a GB300 host. Use the command generated by the panel rather than a separate static copy.
-
-<Accordion title="Reference startup output">
-
-The validated run loaded the target and embedded draft through the stock image's mixed-precision loader. This excerpt is from the real-verification eval; timings and memory availability vary by host.
-
-```text Output
-[2026-10-08 02:22:36] Load weight end. elapsed=1011.56 s, type=Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration, quant=modelopt_mixed, quant_algo=MIXED_PRECISION, avail mem=202.03 GB, mem usage=73.64 GB.
-[2026-10-08 02:23:03] Load weight end. elapsed=25.97 s, type=Qwen4ExpForCausalLMMTP, quant=modelopt_mixed, quant_algo=MIXED_PRECISION, avail mem=197.09 GB, mem usage=4.89 GB.
-```
-
-</Accordion>
-
-#### Serving choices
-
-- **Draft precision:** revision `fc694b54` stores the MTP routed experts in block-scaled FP8 and the rest of the head in BF16. The pinned image, built from SGLang `e00930c5`, preserves this per-layer `modelopt_mixed` configuration. The draft uses the same checkpoint revision as the target. `SGLANG_NVFP4_CKPT_FP8_NEXTN_MOE=0` disables the optional draft precision conversion path; target and draft KV caches stay in BF16.
-- **Hybrid attention:** the recipe selects FlashInfer for linear-attention prefill/decode, Triton for linear verification, and `trtllm_mha` as the attention backend. ReplaySSM speculation, `extra_buffer_lazy`, a tracking interval of 256 and 480 Mamba cache slots retain the qualified state-cache configuration.
-- **Admission and graphs:** the server admits up to 96 requests, uses 16,384-token prefill chunks, and captures full decode graphs at the listed batch sizes up to 96. Prefill graphs remain disabled. The qualification varied client concurrency while retaining these server settings.
-- **CPU offload:** HiCache uses the `kernel` I/O backend, `page_first` layout and `write_back` policy. PLE uses a separate pinned-memory embedding table. See [HiCache design](/docs/advanced_features/hicache_design) for the cache tiers and policies.
-- **API and telemetry:** send requests through the chat-completions API at `http://localhost:30000/v1`, using model name `nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4`. `--reasoning-parser auto` separates reasoning from answer content. Engine metrics and cache reporting remain enabled.
-
-The generated command omits arguments that match the pinned image's defaults, including TP/PP/DP/EP=1, the inherited served-model name and draft MoE backend, full decode graphs, and default Mamba tracking, HiCache layout, PLE backend, tokenizer and scheduler settings. It retains the qualified lane's non-default serving settings. InferenceX-only trace loading, simulated-acceptance controls, client concurrency overrides, result collection and Slurm allocation settings are excluded.
